_doc: Reserved-split manifest (EXP-0013 Phase 1.1 closeout). The layout range named "test" (ids 2000-2199) is reserved for locked held-out evaluations. tests/test_split_guard.py fails if any analysis/predictive_state/*.py file contains the string literal "test" and is not listed here. Listing a file records its historical exposure; it is not permission to add new uses. New exploratory scripts must use "train" or "dev".

allowed_files.env.py: defines the split table (LAYOUT_RANGES) and EXP-0012 TEST_CONDS; no evaluation
allowed_files.lock.py: EXP-0012 preregistration text listing the layout ranges
allowed_files.run_eval.py: EXP-0012 locked TEST evaluation (preregistered gate G1; legitimate held-out scoring of the EXP-0012 models)
allowed_files.report.py: EXP-0012 report generator reading the TEST results
allowed_files.analyze_state.py: EXP-0012 state-probe analysis; defaults to the TEST split (PS_PROBE_SPLIT); EXP-0012 diagnostic, not used by EXP-0013
allowed_files.latency.py: EXP-0012 batch-1 latency traces recorded on TEST layouts with the DIST condition (timing only, no task scoring)
allowed_files._latency_exp0012.py: frozen copy of the EXP-0012 latency step from git history (timing only)
allowed_files.phase11_timing.py: EXP-0013 Phase 1.1 timing: historical traces were recorded on TEST layouts (timing only, no task scoring); closeout makes TRAIN the default and TEST an explicit opt-in (FLEXTERN_ALLOW_TEST_SPLIT=1)

historical_test_exposure.exp0012_task_scoring: run_eval.py / report.py: preregistered TEST evaluation of the EXP-0012 arms (before EXP-0013)
historical_test_exposure.exp0013_phase1_1_timing_traces: phase11_timing.record built E.BatchEnv(1, 'test', DIST) for 15 episodes per trigger (seeds 31..45; layout ids drawn from 2000-2199); used only to time inference; no success metric, tuning, code selection or claim depends on it
historical_test_exposure.exp0013_la_task_scoring_on_test: none: no OccPick2D-LA environment was ever constructed on the test split
